name: What happens after the leak is detected?

mainEntity.name: What happens after the leak is detected?

acceptedAnswer.text: Once a leak is detected, our technician will clearly explain the issue, show you the precise location, and discuss the recommended repair options. You'll receive a detailed estimate for the repair work, outlining the scope and cost. We aim to provide efficient solutions to restore your plumbing system quickly and effectively, minimizing further damage and inconvenience.
acceptedAnswer.description: After detection, the technician explains the leak, shows its location, and provides a detailed estimate for recommended repair options.
